title: IngestedDocument
description: The extracted-text layer of the estate ingestion pipeline: one governed source document, parsed to a single canonical plaintext offset space, before chunking or embedding. Generalizes the Noetica agent-machine doc-store extraction (extractText / extractTextWithPages) into a portable contract so the parse step is not Noetica-private. Every downstream Chunk and ExtractedEntity addresses THIS document's `text` by (start,end) offsets, so the text and its extractionDigest are the shared coordinate system; extractionDigest is RECOMPUTED from `text` by the validator, never read back.

id.description: Stable URN identifier. Pattern: urn:srcos:ingested-document:<local-id>. Identity is stable and never reused.

specVersion.description: Contract version, pinned per the tranche-0001 discipline. Changing this const is a contract change.

docRef.description: URN of the governed source object (Dataset, ArtifactManifest, or content-addressed document).

mimeType.description: IANA media type of the raw bytes (application/pdf, text/plain, ...).

contentHash.description: sha256 of the RAW source bytes (not the extracted text) — content-addresses the input.

text.description: The canonical extracted plaintext. The offset space every Chunk/ExtractedEntity span indexes into.

pageBreaks.description: Optional character offsets where a source page boundary falls, for page-of-offset resolution.

extractionDigest.description: sha256 of `text`. RECOMPUTED by the validator — a digest that is merely stored is an assertion; a recomputed one is a pin.
